import pandas as pd
d = pd.concat([SoBanHang_1__all, SoBanHang_2026__all]).copy()
d = d[d['Mã hóa đơn'].notna()]

    return pd.Timestamp('1899-12-30') + pd.Timedelta(days=int(x)) if isinstance(x, (int, float)) else pd.to_datetime(x, format='%d/%m/%Y')
